pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.4.35: _Idaṁ saṅghassa katikasaṇṭhānaṁ, imaṁ kālaṁ pavisitabbaṁ, imaṁ kālaṁ nikkhamitabbanti_ might be read as “These are the Sangha’s agreements, this is the time to enter, this is the time to leave,” thereby excluding the word “concerning”. In other words, although I have rendered it as such, it is not clear that there is a connection between them. [pli-tv-kd18:1.2.22](), however, makes it clear that the first phrase is to be read in conjunction with the following two.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.5.1: _Mettiyabhūmajakā bhikkhū_ can be read either as referring to two monks, Mettiya and Bhūmajaka, or as a group of monks led by these two. I have not been able to find any clear evidence that it refers to a group, and so I prefer the more straightforward reading that it only refers to the two monks.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.6.14: “Gatehouse” renders _koṭṭhaka_. See Appendix of Technical Terms for discussion.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.7.21: For the rendering of _saṅghāṭi_ as “upper robe”, see Appendix of Technical Terms.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.8.19: “Rapist” renders _dūsita_. See _dūseti_ in Appendix of Technical Terms for discussion.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:1.9.13: “Expel” renders _nāsetha_. For a discussion of the verb _nāseti_, see Appendix of Technical Terms.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.1.4: It is interesting to note that both _uposatha_ and _pavāraṇā_ are here used as distinct from _saṅghakamma_, suggesting neither was regarded as _saṅghakamma_ proper. See Appendix of Technical Terms for a further discussion of these two words.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss8:3.4.2: Sp 1.387: _No kappetīti na saddahati_, “_No kappeti_: he does not believe.”
